stem.text: The diagram represents, for a given temperature, the Boltzmann distribution of the kinetic energies of the molecules in a mixture of two gases that react together. The activation energy for the reaction, $E_\text{a}$, is marked.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution curve of proportion of molecules with a given energy against molecular energy, with the activation energy E_a marked by a vertical line.

stem.text: The dotted curves below show the Boltzmann distribution for the same reaction at a higher temperature. On these diagrams, H represents the activation energy at the higher temperature.

A.alt: Solid Boltzmann curve with a dotted higher-temperature curve; H arrow directly beneath the E_a line.

B.alt: Solid Boltzmann curve with a dotted curve; H arrow at a lower energy than the E_a line, with separate vertical lines at H and E_a.

C.alt: Solid Boltzmann curve with a dotted curve; H arrow directly beneath the E_a line.

D.alt: Solid Boltzmann curve with a dotted curve whose peak is lower than the solid peak and at lower energy; H arrow directly beneath the E_a line.
